prompt: What does the JVM (Java Virtual Machine) do?
choices: Executes Java bytecode (.class files) on any platform
Links C libraries with Java code
explanation: javac compiles .java → .class (bytecode). The JVM executes the bytecode on the specific platform. This is why Java is 'write once, run anywhere' — the same .class runs on any JVM. The JVM also manages memory (garbage collection) and provides the standard library.
